description: Make QuipMac a subscriber to swrm's event spine: when a swrm story is moved to in_progress (Started), surface it on the phone (WebSocket card + APNs push) and inject a notice line into the matching Mac terminal. swrm requires ZERO changes — Quip copies swrm's EventLog.readIncremental reader and tails <root>/.swrm/events.ndjson. All work in QuipMac (Swift). Source PRD: tasks/prd-swrm-board-integration.md. Native: gate = xcodebuild/swift build succeeds + unit tests where noted; on-device/manual verify is the user's pass (note it in the story).

userStories.title: swrm event-log tailer service
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a QuipMac service that incrementally tails a swrm project's .swrm/events.ndjson and delivers parsed events.
acceptanceCriteria: New QuipMac/Services/SwrmEventTailer.swift with start()/stop()

Copies swrm reader contract from swrm native/SwrmCore/Sources/SwrmCore/EventLog.swift: a SwrmEvent struct (seq, ts, project, actor, type, aggregateType, aggregateID, data{from,to,title}) and readIncremental(fileURL:byteOffset:since:)->(events,nextOffset) semantics, torn-trailing-line tolerant (hold partial final segment across pumps)
Per-project byte+seq cursor persisted to QuipMac app-support (NOT inside .swrm/); resumes on restart with no replay or gap (mirror swrm src/events/subscribe.ts cursor authority)
Pumps driven by a DispatchSource/fs watch on the project's .swrm/ directory (watch dir not file) with a poll-timer fallback
Best-effort + non-throwing: missing dir/log logs a warning and no-ops, never crashes
Writes to ~/Library/Logs/Quip/swrm.log via a new LogPaths.swrmPath accessor
Unit test: feed a fixture .ndjson including a torn last line; assert delivered events + advancing cursor
xcodebuild (QuipMac) succeeds
userStories.notes: SwrmEventTailer.swift added (reader copied from swrm EventLog.swift, trimmed data to {title,from,to}; byte+seq cursor in app-support/Quip/swrm/cursors via SwrmCursorStore; .swrm/ dir fs-watch + 2s poll fallback; LogPaths.swrmPath). xcodebuild QuipMac SUCCEEDED. Reader+cursor logic verified via standalone swift run (torn-line hold-back, advancing cursor, seq gate, missing-file no-op all pass). XCTest SwrmEventTailerTests written + compiles, but the QuipMacTests host hangs headless in this env ('test runner hung before establishing connection') — PRE-EXISTING: existing suites (e.g. WhisperOutputCleanerTests) hang identically. User should run tests from Xcode to confirm.

userStories.title: Configurable swrm project roots + Settings UI
userStories.description: As a user, I want to tell Quip which swrm projects to watch.
acceptanceCriteria: A list of swrm project root paths persists in UserDefaults under 'swrmProjectRoots' (JSON [String]), following the registeredPushDevices persistence pattern (PushNotificationService.swift)
A Settings section in the existing SettingsView (QuipMacApp.swift) lists configured roots with add (folder picker) + remove
Add validates the path contains or can contain a .swrm/ dir; invalid paths show an inline error
One SwrmEventTailer runs per configured root; add/remove starts/stops its tailer live (no app restart)
xcodebuild succeeds; manual: add the swrm repo root, confirm it persists across relaunch (user verify)
userStories.notes: Added QuipMac/Services/SwrmProjectStore.swift (@MainActor @Observable): roots persisted to UserDefaults key 'swrmProjectRoots' as JSON [String] (PushNotificationService pattern); one SwrmEventTailer per root in a [path:tailer] dict; add(path:)/remove(path:) start/stop a tailer live; validate(path:) rejects non-existing-folder + dupes (a dir can always gain a .swrm/ subdir, so existing-dir is the gate). startAll()/stopAll() exist for US-008 app-launch wiring but are NOT called at init. onTailerEvents hook (didSet rewires running tailers) is the seam US-004/US-008 consume. Added SwrmTab to QuipMac/Views/SettingsView.swift (folder-picker add, inline error, per-root remove, ContentUnavailableView empty state) + tabItem; wired .environment(swrmProjectStore) into the Settings scene and @State in QuipMacApp. xcodegen regen + xcodebuild QuipMac BUILD SUCCEEDED. Manual (user verify): add the swrm repo root, confirm it persists across relaunch.

userStories.title: Story title resolution (file-only)
userStories.description: As a user, I want the started-story notice to show the title, even though task.moved carries only {from,to}.
acceptanceCriteria: Tailer maintains an in-memory title cache keyed by aggregateID, populated from task.created and task.planned events (which carry data.title) as they stream
On task.moved to in_progress, title is looked up from the cache by aggregateID
Cold-start cache miss: tailer does a one-shot full EventLog.read(projectRoot:) at startup to seed the cache, then tails incrementally
Fallback when title still unknown: 'Story #<id>' (no crash, no blank)
No swrm SQLite access (file-only)
Unit test: created-then-moved fixture yields the title; moved-without-prior-created yields 'Story #<id>'
xcodebuild succeeds
userStories.notes: Added title cache to SwrmEventTailer: private(set) titleCache [aggregateID:title]. ingestTitles(from:) absorbs data.title from task.created/task.planned (Set titleBearingTypes), later title wins. resolvedTitle(forAggregateID:) returns cached or 'Story #<id>' fallback. seedTitleCache() does a one-shot SwrmEventReader.read(projectRoot:) full-history read at start() (cursor-independent — recovers titles from a created consumed in a prior run, behind the byte cursor); synchronous, file-only, no SQLite. Pump ingests each delivered batch BEFORE onEvents (seq-sorted ⇒ created precedes same-batch moved). xcodebuild QuipMac BUILD SUCCEEDED. Cache logic verified via standalone swift run (created→moved, planned seed, fallback, later-title-wins ALL PASS). Added 5 XCTest cases (SwrmEventTailerTests, @MainActor); test host hangs headless per US-001 — user runs from Xcode.

userStories.title: Trigger filter + phone card over WebSocket
userStories.description: As a user, I want a card on my phone the moment a story is Started.
acceptanceCriteria: Pure trigger predicate (unit-tested): type=='task.moved' && data.to=='in_progress'
New outbound message type in Shared/MessageProtocol.swift: SwrmStoryStartedMessage { type='swrm_story_started', project, taskId, title, ts }
On trigger QuipMac calls webSocketServer.broadcast(_:) (WebSocketServer.swift) with that message
QuipiOS handles 'swrm_story_started' and renders a card/toast (title + project)
No regression to existing message handling (unknown types already ignored)
xcodebuild (QuipMac + QuipiOS) succeeds; manual: move a swrm card to In Progress -> phone shows the card (user verify)
userStories.notes: Added SwrmStoryStartedMessage {type='swrm_story_started', project, taskId, title, ts} to Shared/MessageProtocol.swift (in both Mac + iOS targets via ../Shared). Pure trigger predicate SwrmEvent.isStoryStarted (type=='task.moved' && data.to=='in_progress') in SwrmEventTailer.swift — unit-tested (4 cases: in_progress true; other column false; nil-to false; non-moved type false). New QuipMac/Services/SwrmStoryCoordinator.swift (@MainActor): handle(tailer:events:) filters by isStoryStarted, resolves title via tailer.resolvedTitle (US-003), project = event.project ?? root basename, broadcasts the card via webSocketServer.broadcast. Wired in QuipMacApp.startServicesOnce: swrmStoryCoordinator.webSocketServer = webSocketServer + swrmProjectStore.onTailerEvents = coordinator.handle (the US-002 seam). iOS 3-layer chain: WebSocketClient.onSwrmStoryStarted + 'swrm_story_started' case; BackendConnectionManager onSwrmStoryStarted decl + wire() bridge (active-session gated); QuipApp host renders via existing errorToast banner ('swrm ▶ <title> · <project>', 4s). xcodebuild QuipMac + QuipiOS BUILD SUCCEEDED. Unknown-type default case already ignores -> no regression. NOTE: QA sim UDID is now 3B2ACF04-1B0A-4842-827C-5B1699B8D4F8 (memory had stale D853A014). Tests need Xcode/user run (test host hangs headless per US-001). Manual (user verify): move a swrm card to In Progress -> phone shows the toast.

userStories.title: APNs push for a started story
userStories.description: As a user, I want a push even when Quip is backgrounded.
acceptanceCriteria: On trigger, send an APNs push to all registered devices via APNsClient.send(payloadData:toDevice:collapseId:), building the payload like PushNotificationService.buildPayload
Title 'Started - <project>'; body '<story title> -> In Progress'
Payload includes quip_event:'swrm_story_started' + quip_swrm_task_id
Respects existing per-device prefs (paused, quiet hours) reusing PushNotificationService gating
collapseId = 'swrm-<project>-<taskId>' so repeated moves of one story collapse
xcodebuild succeeds; manual: background Quip, move a card -> push arrives (user verify)

userStories.title: Capture full terminal working-directory path
userStories.description: As a developer, I need each tracked terminal's full cwd (not just basename) so a project root can be matched exactly.
acceptanceCriteria: WindowManager.fetchSubtitles() is extended to ALSO capture the full path from iTerm's variable named 'path' (currently reduced to basename)
ManagedWindow gains a cwdPath: String? field set alongside subtitle
Existing subtitle (basename) behavior unchanged (no UI regression)
Terminal.app windows (no shell-var access) leave cwdPath nil, handled gracefully downstream
xcodebuild succeeds; manual: open an iTerm session in a known dir, confirm cwdPath is the full path (user verify)

userStories.title: Inject a notice line into the matching terminal
userStories.description: As a user, I want the Started story echoed into the Claude terminal for that project.
acceptanceCriteria: On trigger, find the tracked window whose cwdPath == <project root_path> (exact; if multiple, most-recently-active; if none, skip silently + log)
Inject a single notice line via KeystrokeInjector.sendText(_:to:pressReturn:terminalApp:iterm2SessionId:) using the window's iterm2SessionId
No auto-submit: notice is informational text (e.g. '# swrm: started "<title>" (#<id>)') injected with pressReturn:false; must NOT execute or send a prompt
Never steals focus (use the session-id iTerm path, not window-focus injection)
Terminal.app windows (no iterm2SessionId) skipped with a logged note (MVP = iTerm2 only)
xcodebuild succeeds; manual: move a swrm card -> matching iTerm shows the notice line, unsubmitted (user verify)

userStories.title: Lifecycle wiring + end-to-end verification

A single coordinator wires tailer trigger -> (US-004 card, US-005 push, US-007 inject), each independently best-effort
First-launch seeds cursor to latest seq (no historical-move notification storm)
